verdict.rationale: Bento documents at least one named framework integration: the Google ADK extra captures every call automatically. It also says it captures LLM calls at the SDK level, ingests spans from any framework over OpenTelemetry (in TypeScript with no Bento package), and offers bento.track_ai as a manual fallback for SDKs without an integration. However, none of the specific integrations named in the story are evidenced, so this is broad OTel-based support rather than a documented integration catalog. missing for 10: explicit LangChain, OpenAI SDK, and Vercel AI SDK integrations, a documented list of supported frameworks, independent or hands-on corroboration.
